code: # Sampling & gap logic nominal_fix_sec <- 10 # intended sampling interval (s) delta_t_sec <- 3 * 60 # standby gap threshold (>= 3 min) delta_d_m <- 150 # distance threshold for "no movement" during a gap (m) gap_big_sec <- 15 * 60 # "big" gap threshold (s) gap_strategy <- "exclude" # {"exclude", "carry_forward"} cap_carry_forward <- 5 * 60 # cap when carrying forward (s)   # Daytime window (local time) tz_local <- "Europe/Zurich" day_start_hr <- 7 day_end_hr <- 22 # [start, end)

title: Greenness Exposure: A Walkthrough
text: Efficiently compute seconds overlap interval [s, e) union daily daytime windows.
code: fast_day_overlap <- function(s, e, tz = "Europe/Zurich", day_start_hr = 7, day_end_hr = 22) { stopifnot(inherits(s, "POSIXct"), inherits(e, "POSIXct"))   s_loc <- lubridate::with_tz(s, tz) e_loc <- lubridate::with_tz(e, tz)   valid <- !is.na(s_loc) & !is.na(e_loc) & (e_loc > s_loc) out <- numeric(length(s)) if (!any(valid)) return(out)   s_loc <- s_loc[valid]; e_loc <- e_loc[valid] sd <- lubridate::floor_date(s_loc, "day") ed <- lubridate::floor_date(e_loc, "day") same_day <- sd == ed   to_num <- function(x) as.numeric(x)   f_start <- pmax(to_num(s_loc), to_num(sd + lubridate::hours(day_start_hr))) f_end <- pmin(to_num(e_loc), to_num(sd + lubridate::hours(day_end_hr))) first <- pmax(f_end - f_start, 0)   l_start <- pmax(to_num(ed + lubridate::hours(day_start_hr)), to_num(s_loc)) l_end <- pmin(to_num(e_loc), to_num(ed + lubridate::hours(day_end_hr))) last <- pmax(l_end - l_start, 0) last[same_day] <- 0   n_days <- as.integer(difftime(ed, sd, units = "days")) mid_days <- pmax(n_days - 1L, 0L) window_len <- (day_end_hr - day_start_hr) * 3600 mid <- mid_days * window_len   res <- first + last + mid out[valid] <- res out }

what: Step 4. Interval metrics and gap handling
title: Greenness Exposure: A Walkthrough
text: keep intervals daytime_overlap_sec > 0 day_dwell_sec = NA? still contribute missing daytime coverage, quantify later.
code: # Distance function (geodist preferred for speed/accuracy) .Geodesic <- function(lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2) {   if (requireNamespace("geodist", quietly = TRUE)) {     geodist::geodist_vec(lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2, paired = TRUE, measure = "geodesic")   } else {     # Fallback: simple Haversine via base math (approximate)     rad <- pi/180     R <- 6371000     dlon <- (lon2 - lon1) * rad     dlat <- (lat2 - lat1) * rad     a <- sin(dlat/2)^2 + cos(lat1 * rad) * cos(lat2 * rad) * sin(dlon/2)^2     2 * R * atan2(sqrt(a), sqrt(1 - a))   } }   gps_expo <- gps_data |>   arrange(subject, timestamp) |>   group_by(subject) |>   mutate(   next_time = dplyr::lead(timestamp),   next_lat = dplyr::lead(lat),   next_lon = dplyr::lead(lon),   dt_sec = as.numeric(difftime(next_time, timestamp, units = "secs")),   dist_m = .Geodesic(lon, lat, next_lon, next_lat),         # Classify interval [timestamp, next_time)   is_gap = dt_sec > nominal_fix_sec,   standby_gap = is_gap & dt_sec >= delta_t_sec & dist_m <= delta_d_m,   big_uncertain = is_gap & (dist_m > delta_d_m | dt_sec >= gap_big_sec)   ) |>   mutate(   dwell_eff_sec = dplyr::case_when(   big_uncertain & gap_strategy == "exclude" ~ NA_real_,   big_uncertain & gap_strategy == "carry_forward" ~ pmin(dt_sec, cap_carry_forward),   TRUE ~ dt_sec   )   ) |>   mutate(   daytime_overlap_sec = fast_day_overlap(timestamp, next_time, tz = tz_local,   day_start_hr = day_start_hr, day_end_hr = day_end_hr),   day_dwell_sec = pmin(daytime_overlap_sec, dwell_eff_sec)   ) |>   ungroup() |>   # Keep intervals that intersect daytime (including those we mark missing for exposure)   filter(day_dwell_sec > 0 | (!is.na(day_dwell_sec) & daytime_overlap_sec > 0))

title: Greenness Exposure: A Walkthrough
text: Weighted means (time frequency-like weight) unbiased weighted SD: section turns per-interval contributions per-subject (typically per-day) exposure metrics. averaged? interval already computed: - day_dwell_sec_i — seconds valid daytime dwell, - ndvi_mean_i, frac_green_core_i, frac_grey_i — attributes interval’s H3 cell, - expo_contrib_*_i = attribute_i × day_dwell_sec_i — exposure contribution “(attribute × seconds)”. Time-weighted means. attribute \(x\) (e.g., NDVI), time-weighted mean exposure contribution summed intervals, divided total valid daytime seconds: \[ \bar{x}_{\text{time-w}} = \frac{\sum_i x_i \cdot t_i}{\sum_i t_i} \quad \text{} t_i = \text{day\_dwell\_sec}_i. \] Implementation-wise, exactly: - ndvi_time_weighted  = sum(expo_contrib_ndvi)  / sum(day_dwell_sec) - green_time_weighted = sum(expo_contrib_green) / sum(day_dwell_sec) - grey_time_weighted  = sum(expo_contrib_grey)  / sum(day_dwell_sec) Unbiased weighted SD.wtd_sd_unbiased(x, w) computes dispersion measure treats w frequency-like weights (seconds). uses: \[ s_w = \sqrt{\frac{\sum_i w_i (x_i - \bar{x}_w)^2}{\,\sum_i w_i - \frac{\sum_i w_i^2}{\sum_i w_i}\,}}, \] reduces small-sample bias get just divide \(\sum w_i\). (denominator becomes non-positive—e.g., one effective observation—returns NA.) Coverage missingness. - valid_day_sec = sum(day_dwell_sec) total usable daytime seconds. - missing_day_sec = sum(missing_day_sec) daytime overlapped interval excluded (e.g., “big/uncertain” gaps chosen strategy). - coverage_valid_share = valid_day_sec / (valid_day_sec + missing_day_sec + 1e-9) reports share daytime covered valid exposure, tiny epsilon avoid division zero. also compute unweighted (unique-tile) stats? Time-weighted metrics reflect time actually spent. GPS sampling (dwell) can overweight locations people linger. benchmark , also take one record per unique H3 cell (per subject-day) compute simple means/SDs across unique tiles: - answers: “’s average environment across set places visited?” (equal weight per place), versus “’s average environment experienced time?” (equal weight per second). Concretely, tile_uniques keeps distinct (subject, date, h3, …) rows takes plain means/SDs ndvi_mean, frac_green_core, frac_grey. Joining results. Finally, join time-weighted unique-tile summaries can compare side--side unit analysis.
code: wtd_sd_unbiased <- function(x, w) {   ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(w) & (w > 0)   x <- x[ok]; w <- w[ok]   if (length(x) == 0L) return(NA_real_)   W <- sum(w)   if (W <= 0) return(NA_real_)   mu <- sum(w * x) / W   num <- sum(w * (x - mu)^2)   W2 <- sum(w^2)   denom <- W - (W2 / W) # unbiased for frequency-like weights   if (denom <= 0) return(NA_real_)   sqrt(num / denom) } daily_weighted <- gps_expo_rich %>%   mutate(date = as_date(with_tz(timestamp, tz_local))) %>%   group_by(subject) %>%   # or use    # group_by(subject, date) %>%   summarise(     ndvi_time_weighted  = sum(expo_contrib_ndvi,  na.rm = TRUE) / sum(day_dwell_sec, na.rm = TRUE),     green_time_weighted = sum(expo_contrib_green, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(day_dwell_sec, na.rm = TRUE),     grey_time_weighted  = sum(expo_contrib_grey,  na.rm = TRUE) / sum(day_dwell_sec, na.rm = TRUE),          ndvi_sd_weighted    = wtd_sd_unbiased(ndvi_mean,       day_dwell_sec),     green_sd_weighted   = wtd_sd_unbiased(frac_green_core, day_dwell_sec),     grey_sd_weighted    = wtd_sd_unbiased(frac_grey,       day_dwell_sec),          valid_day_sec        = sum(day_dwell_sec,   na.rm = TRUE),     missing_day_sec      = sum(missing_day_sec, na.rm = TRUE),     coverage_valid_share = valid_day_sec / (valid_day_sec + missing_day_sec + 1e-9),     .groups = "drop"   )  # Step 2: Unweighted stats per subject-date using unique H3 tiles tile_uniques <- gps_expo_rich %>%   mutate(date = as_date(with_tz(timestamp, tz_local))) %>%   distinct(subject, date, h3, ndvi_mean, frac_green_core, frac_grey) %>%   group_by(subject) %>%   summarise(     ndvi_mean_unweighted   = mean(ndvi_mean,        na.rm = TRUE),     ndvi_sd_unweighted     = sd(ndvi_mean,          na.rm = TRUE),     green_mean_unweighted  = mean(frac_green_core,  na.rm = TRUE),     green_sd_unweighted    = sd(frac_green_core,    na.rm = TRUE),     grey_mean_unweighted   = mean(frac_grey,        na.rm = TRUE),     grey_sd_unweighted     = sd(frac_grey,          na.rm = TRUE),     .groups = "drop"   )  # Step 3: Join weighted and unweighted results expo_daily <- daily_weighted %>%   left_join(tile_uniques, by = c("subject"))  expo_daily

what: Step 8. Comparing weighted vs. unweighted exposure metrics
title: Greenness Exposure: A Walkthrough
text: following code explores time-weighted unweighted (unique-tile) summaries differ. Overall averages across subjects/days. first collapse expo_daily single row taking mean metric: ndvi_time_weighted, green_time_weighted, grey_time_weighted: mean exposures weighted time spent. ndvi_mean_unweighted, green_mean_unweighted, grey_mean_unweighted: mean exposures visited H3 tile counted equally. gives quick population-level comparison. Distribution plots. Using pivot_longer(), reshape data three indicators (NDVI, green, grey) can plotted single ggplot. First plot: distribution time-weighted exposures across units. Second plot: distribution unweighted exposures across units. simple dot plots show spread relative levels indicators. Scatterplots: weighted vs. unweighted. compare metrics directly: NDVI: geom_point(aes(x = ndvi_time_weighted, y = ndvi_mean_unweighted)). Green: geom_point(aes(x = green_time_weighted, y = green_mean_unweighted)) regression line (geom_smooth(method = "lm")). Grey: similar scatter weighted vs. unweighted. plots assess agreement: points close diagonal (x=y) indicate weighting makes little difference. Systematic deviations show effect accounting dwell time. Axes limited [0,1] since metrics proportions normalized indices. Correlation diagnostics. compute correlations weighted unweighted versions metric (NDVI, green, grey). green, also square correlation (^2) report \(R^2\), .e. variance explained linear fit. Optional: mapping time across H3 cells. understand time spent, aggregate total minutes per (subject, date, h3) tile: tile_minutes = sum(day_dwell_sec)/60 daytime duration. tile_ndvi NDVI tile. convert H3 indices polygons (h3jsr::cell_to_polygon) plot geom_sf(fill = tile_minutes). resulting map shows spatial hotspots time spent, .e. exposure “footprint” subject. Together, summaries allow : - Compare central tendencies weighted vs. unweighted exposure. - Inspect degree agreement (bias) introduced time-weighting. - Visualize spatial distribution time spent support interpretation.
code: expo_daily |>    summarize(ndvi_time_weighted = mean(ndvi_time_weighted),             green_time_weighted = mean(green_time_weighted),             grey_time_weighted = mean(grey_time_weighted))  expo_daily |>    summarize(ndvi_mean_unweighted = mean(ndvi_mean_unweighted),             green_mean_unweighted = mean(green_mean_unweighted),             grey_mean_unweighted = mean(grey_mean_unweighted))  expo_daily |>    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c("ndvi_time_weighted","green_time_weighted","grey_time_weighted")) |>   ggplot() +    geom_point(aes(x=name, y= value))  expo_daily |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c("ndvi_mean_unweighted","green_mean_unweighted","grey_mean_unweighted")) |>   ggplot() +    geom_point(aes(x=name, y= value))  expo_daily |>   ggplot() +   geom_point(aes(x=ndvi_time_weighted,ndvi_mean_unweighted ))+   xlim(0,1)+ylim(0,1)  expo_daily |>   ggplot(aes(x=green_time_weighted,green_mean_unweighted )) +   geom_point()+   xlim(0,1)+ylim(0,1)+   labs(y= "prop. green unweighted", x = "prop. green time-weighted")+   geom_smooth(method= "lm")+   hrbrthemes::theme_ipsum()  cor(expo_daily$green_mean_unweighted, expo_daily$green_time_weighted)^2   expo_daily |>   ggplot() +   geom_point(aes(x=grey_time_weighted,grey_mean_unweighted ))+   xlim(0,1)+ylim(0,1)    cor(expo_daily$ndvi_mean_unweighted, expo_daily$ndvi_time_weighted) cor(expo_daily$green_mean_unweighted, expo_daily$green_time_weighted) cor(expo_daily$grey_mean_unweighted, expo_daily$grey_time_weighted)   # Optional: how time is distributed across H3 tiles during daytime tile_time_daily <- gps_expo %>%   mutate(date = as_date(with_tz(timestamp, tz_local))) %>%   group_by(subject, date, h3) %>%   summarise(     tile_minutes = sum(day_dwell_sec, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,     tile_ndvi    = first(ndvi_mean),     .groups = "drop"   )  ggplot(tile_time_daily |> mutate(geometry = h3jsr::cell_to_polygon(h3))) + geom_sf(aes(fill = tile_minutes, geometry = geometry))

Defaults c("subject","date"). "date" included present data, derived timestamp tz_local add_date_if_missing = TRUE. value_cols Named character vector mapping metric names columns, e.g. c(ndvi = "ndvi_mean", green = "frac_green_core",   grey = "frac_grey"). name m, function produces m_time_weighted, m_sd_weighted, , enabled, m_mean_unweighted, m_sd_unweighted. weight_col Name weight column (seconds), default "day_dwell_sec". absent auto_compute_weights = TRUE, weights derived (see Details). weight_fun Optional function applied weights summarization; signature function(w) w. Examples: cap weights function(w) pmin(w, 300), presence-function(w) .numeric(w > 0), function(w) sqrt(w). aoi_id Optional AOI identifier column (e.g., "h3" "buffer_id"). supplied include_unweighted = TRUE, unweighted unique-AOI summaries computed per group. include_unweighted Logical; TRUE (default), compute unweighted statistics across unique AOIs per group (one row per AOI). coverage_cols Named character vector names c(valid = "day_dwell_sec", missing = "missing_day_sec"). columns exist group, coverage metrics reported (see Details). tz_local Time zone used derive date timestamp evaluate daytime windows. Default "UTC". add_date_if_missing Logical; TRUE (default) "date" group missing data, derive timestamp tz_local. auto_compute_weights Logical; TRUE (default) weight_col absent, compute day_dwell_sec missing_day_sec successive fixes (see Details). nominal_fix_sec Intended sampling interval seconds; used detect gaps. Default 10. delta_t_sec Standby-gap threshold seconds (movement least long). Default 3*60. delta_d_m Distance threshold meters consider "movement" across gap. Default 150. gap_big_sec Threshold (seconds) classifying gap "big/uncertain". Default 15*60. gap_strategy Strategy big/uncertain gaps: "exclude" (mark missing) "carry_forward" (cap carry-forward dwell). Default c("exclude","carry_forward"), first value used. cap_carry_forward Cap seconds gap_strategy = "carry_forward". title: Summarize greenness exposure with (auto) time-weighting — summarize_exposure
text: data.frame one row per group containing summary columns described . Returned invisibly.

title: Summarize greenness exposure with (auto) time-weighting — summarize_exposure
text: Auto-computation weights (weight_col missing). subject, consecutive GPS fixes define intervals \([t_i, t_{+1})\) duration \(d_i = t_{+1} - t_i\) (seconds) displacement \(\Delta s_i\) (meters; Haversine). Gaps identified \(d_i > \mathrm{nominal\_fix\_sec}\). gap standby \(d_i \ge \mathrm{delta\_t\_sec}\) \(\Delta s_i \le \mathrm{delta\_d\_m}\). gap big/uncertain \(\Delta s_i > \mathrm{delta\_d\_m}\) \(d_i \ge \mathrm{gap\_big\_sec}\). Effective dwell interval \(\) : $$   \tilde{d}_i =   \begin{cases}     \mathrm{NA}, & \text{big/uncertain strategy = exclude} \\     \min(d_i, C), & \text{big/uncertain strategy = carry\_forward} \\     d_i, & \text{otherwise,}   \end{cases} $$ \(C\) carry-forward cap (seconds). Let \(O_i\) overlap (seconds) \([t_i, t_{+1})\) local daytime window \([H_{\mathrm{start}}, H_{\mathrm{end}})\) (evaluated tz_local). daytime dwell weight missing daytime seconds : $$w_i = \min(\tilde{d}_i, O_i),$$ $$   m_i =   \begin{cases}     O_i, & \text{} w_i \text{ NA } O_i > 0 \\     0,   & \text{otherwise.}   \end{cases} $$ function stores \(w_i\) day_dwell_sec (weight_col) \(m_i\) missing_day_sec. Intervals \(O_i = 0\) dropped. Weights may transformed via weight_fun(w) use. Time-weighted summaries. attribute \(x_i\) (e.g., NDVI) weights \(w_i\), time-weighted mean $$\bar{x}_w = \frac{\sum_i w_i x_i}{\sum_i w_i}.$$ unbiased weighted standard deviation frequency-like weights $$   s_w = \sqrt{     \frac{\sum_i w_i (x_i - \bar{x}_w)^2}{       \sum_i w_i - \frac{\sum_i w_i^2}{\sum_i w_i}     }   }. $$ denominator non-positive, NA returned. Coverage. coverage_cols$valid (e.g., day_dwell_sec) coverage_cols$missing (e.g., missing_day_sec) exist, coverage $$   \mathrm{coverage} =   \frac{\sum_i \mathrm{valid}_i}{\sum_i \mathrm{valid}_i + \sum_i \mathrm{missing}_i}. $$

title: Summarize greenness exposure with (auto) time-weighting — summarize_exposure
text: name m value_cols, output includes: m_time_weighted: time-weighted mean. m_sd_weighted: unbiased weighted SD. m_mean_unweighted, m_sd_unweighted (requested): unweighted mean/SD across unique AOIs group. coverage inputs present: valid_day_sec, missing_day_sec: sums across group. coverage_valid_share: \(\[0,1]\). Grouping columns (group) preserved appear first.
